evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked — call went straight into re-verifying an existing quote's email, address, and date change
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's questions were all pricing-mechanics logistics (fifteen-minute increments, minimum math) — no personal concern raised, no-concern-raised exception applied
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we only charge every fifteen minutes... you only pay for how long it would take after the minimum" (beats-it-pay-less, explained at length) + parking/walking-distance-driven range change (window); no rate-commitment, self-prep-tip, or fairness-check lines

top_strength: Extremely patient and precise walking the customer through the fifteen-minute-increment math line by line — built real trust on the mechanics of the quote.
coaching_note: Treated this as a pure logistics-update call and skipped the differentiators entirely — even a requote call should work in damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, and On-Time/Communication somewhere, since none of them had been covered on this call before.
